about: Snapshot of the Clean a Cat Launch Plan page database, collection answers, read 2026-11-25 18:16 UTC (1:16 PM ET). 102 documents. q2 documents are verbatim. q2-queue.note: A bench and a pick make it all done through the menu like shown in the menu draft but also have a menu that just says pick next in line or something along those lines make sure the menu still holds clean and the cats look dirtier in their pictures the more dirty they are and take more steps to clean. Rarer the cat the more likely its dirtier/has more steps but pays a lot more. All cats should have a base money amount but that can increase/multiply based on how fast you cleaned them(stars received),how long the cat waited if above a certain wait time  like within the first 10% of heart bar it should be a big bonus multiplier, (heart bar) they should have no penalty if it was above another certain amount and if he was  and how dirty there were (how many steps it took) making it more worthwhile to take the dirtier rare ones really quick. When helpers clean the cats they also get bonuses based on those things but make it much less and make them take longer the dirtier the cat is, also for the helpers add a "mode" that you can change for them like do the prioritize cats about to leave, rarest cats, dirtiest cats first, cats that are first in line, etc...
